consumerAdaptations: Import paths bind to the existing native Designer UI exports and Studio modules.
Sidebar-15 left slots retain existing Publisher navigation, consumer brand endpoint and local workspace profile; workspace display name is Clossys Studio regardless of brand loading state.

Sidebar-07 single-option workspace/profile rows omit only dropdown/action affordances and retain all native SidebarMenuButton base/default/lg classes. Static div adapter explicitly calls the native useSidebar context guard.
Existing profile initials remain the fallback; no avatar image or account data is fabricated.

Sidebar-15 right calendar sample slots bind to the existing unconnected chat empty state. Stock resizable Panel/Separator handles right width; sidebar width binds to its panel at 100%, with native 16rem default/minimum and 50% maximum.
Chat mobile Sheet mirrors native Sidebar mobile attributes/classes and 18rem width, with existing chat open state and accessible title/description.
Stock asChild PopoverTrigger and TooltipTrigger share one stock icon button. Existing URL, keyboard, scroll-spy, prompt and command behavior is retained; legacy link clipboard fallback is excluded.

Designer HeaderEdgeToggle shares the sidebar-15 header trigger/Separator pair on both edges, mirrored by child order only. Separator data selectors adapt to the actual native Aria orientation attribute and self alignment; stock header gap-2 supplies equal spacing, replacing the left-only mr-2.
Theme button binds existing resolved/setMode provider API; body retains the required @container/main ancestor.
The qualified header alignment patch binds the right chat header to the page header h-14; the exact stock h-16 source remains recorded above.
limitations: Sidebar-15 is natively fixed geometry: the left Rail toggles; it does not drag-resize. Right resizing uses stock resizable rather than an invented sidebar drag API.

Page and right chat headers now share h-14. Left native offcanvas transition and right panel conditional snap are not claimed matched. A shared resizing/motion decision is required before visual parity acceptance.
Source preparation only; no new records, pins, approvals, versions, certification or served UI clearance.

operations: Keep the complete SectionCards grid literal and first Card anatomy/classes; repeat it over supplied agents.

Bind description to agent label, numeric title to total IA slots, badge to slots with candidates, footer to pinned slot count and supplied purpose. Counts are input only; legacy renderer/map counts are not consumed.
Replace IconPlaceholder with the supplied size-4 agent icon. Add stable React key, heading/aria labels and nonvisual census metadata.
Loading/error/missing use the same anatomy with an em dash instead of a number and explicit state text; error detail is supplied input. No zero fallback, inferred counts, or navigation button.
Extract the stock inner vertical wrapper opening; replace its example children with the existing ordered leaf-card dataset. Do not copy a page/frame shell.
Extract the whole SkeletonCard CardContent body in place of the existing preview loading body. Bind aria-label only.
Extract the CardLogin inline anchor; bind href and text to the existing projected leaf route and name inside the existing title. No new button styling.
Extract CardDefault header anatomy with default classes; bind title/description and heading semantics. Existing optional notice remains outside this extracted part.
Extract BlockViewerIframe only; relocate cn import, replace app context with src/iframeKey/iframeHeight props, preserving the iframe tag, lazy loading, default height 930 and complete class literal.

Bind src only to projected same-origin specimen routes; add accessible title and inert state plus a local stable id/ref. No app toolbar, code viewer, analytics, desktop-only wrapper, frame ratio or new visual class.

Bound content-size adaptation listens only after matching load, to this exact connected element/id/window/source URL on the same origin. Require the existing message type, exact expected viewport, finite positive numeric height and measured width; scale and cap height at the supplied initial height (default 930, maximum 10000). ResizeObserver re-fits the last valid dimensions.

A key covering source/identity/viewport/height remounts the iframe on input changes. Load clears prior dimensions; cleanup removes listeners/observer and rejects stale callbacks. The current server message has no nonce/id field; local element/id identity does not assert an upstream message-id protocol.
Require the projected URL width and supplied viewport to agree; only the existing 1280 route default is accepted when width is absent.
Use the existing stock CardDescription default, removing only the obsolete local --measure class. Existing detail data, tables, status rows and layout remain unchanged.
